name: parametric beamsplitter implementations in circuit QED
provenance: Compiled by Lukas Splitthoff for a literature overview of parametric beamsplitter implementations, INDEPENDENTLY of this pipeline and before any run of it was seen. DOIs taken from references_PBC.bib.
why_this_matters: known_items elsewhere in this repo are papers an earlier run of the same search found, so they only guard against regression. This list was chosen by a domain expert who had not seen the output, which makes recall against it a real measurement rather than the system grading its own homework.
scope: Parametric beamsplitter (a-dagger b + h.c.) implementations in superconducting circuit QED, 2010-2025, grouped by coupler type: JRM, SQUID, transmon-mediated, SNAIL, DDS, LINC.
